decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans numbered 3025 A, 4005 B, 4101, 4103 A, 6337/G1/E2, 6337/G1/E1, 6337/G1/GD submitted 22nd June 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the commencement of the development hereby permitted details of vents and air conditioning units to be used and how they would be fixed to the building, including samples if so required, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and all the vents and air conditioning units used in the development shall conform to the details/samples so approved.

Condition : 4 - No work permitted by this consent shall commence until a detailed specification of the proposed mortar mix and profile has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out using the approved specification. 
No work permitted by this consent shall commence until details of the extent of repointing and an unobtrusive sample area of brick / stonework etc has been repointed first and the colour, texture and finish has been agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out using the approved details.

Condition : 5 - Upon completion of the works hereby approved, any damage caused to the building by the works shall be made good within 3 months in accordance with a scheme submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority

Condition : 6 - For the avoidance of doubt, fixing points into any part of the existing building shall be kept at a minimum and should be made into the mortar joints between the stones using non-ferrous fixings, the details of which shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Planning Authority prior to any works on site.

Condition : 7 - No work permitted by this consent shall commence until details of the extent of repointing and an unobtrusive sample area of brick / stonework etc has been repointed first and the colour, texture and finish has been agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out using the approved details.
description: Listed building consent for the installation of four heat recovery units along the side of the building and a new air conditioning unit in place of an existing air conditioning unit.
